purpose: Extend the existing verified external corpus from run 43811430834 with licensed real video payloads and external tool examples. Require real, usable external records from all five families—text, tool use, image, audio and video—in train, validation and test before tokenizer fitting. Then initialize OneCore from random weights and run 150 joint optimizer steps on GitHub Actions CPU, with one external sample from each family per optimizer update. Bootstrap, synthetic and owner-curated examples remain diagnostic-only and are excluded from tokenizer, optimizer and generalization metrics.
